tickets.title: The witness and ring budgets are 600 ms by default (**amendment 10, 2026-10-22**)

authority.locator: P72 · section 2 of amendment 10; R-P236; lanes L12–L15 and R-P217(3), R-P229, R-P235
authority.requirement: see amendment 10 section 2, ticket P72 (copied verbatim in the specification)

tickets.outcome: A decision with no override waits up to 600 ms for the lift witness and the ring read instead of 200 ms, so a warm read on the platform (measured at 204–378 ms, largest 478 ms inside a warm tail) is served rather than withheld; the bounded override of P62 is unchanged; the kit states the budgets and why.

criteria.observable: On both hosts a decision made with no budget override admits and reports sources.budgets {"lift":600,"ring":600} with no refused member, and the exported defaults LIFT_WITNESS_BUDGET_MS and RING_READ_BUDGET_MS read 600; today: 200 and 200.
criteria.proof: The P72 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P72.BD1 in src/units/P72 and they pass.

criteria.observable: The bounded override of P62 is unchanged in form: an override of 599 is admitted and reported, an override at or above 5000 is refused with the default of 600 in force and sources.budgets.refused naming it, on both hosts; P62's locks that pin the number 200 are read as the exported defaults (test-only R10).
criteria.proof: The P72 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P72.BD2 in src/units/P72, and the P62 locks, and they pass.

criteria.observable: The kit statements of the budgets (kit 02 :369 and the heartbeat/cost paragraph; kit 03's budget and sources.budgets statements) and the commented wrangler.toml lines state 600 ms and the reason (one edge round trip to a warm statistics object measured at up to 378 ms; the budget bounds the wait, not the read); today they state 200.
criteria.proof: The P72 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P72.BD3 in src/units/P72 and they pass.

criteria.observable: The released artifact shows the behaviour of every LOCAL criterion on both deployed shopper hosts at the default budgets with no override: P70's §2 probe at 75 s and 300 s and one lift reader each of P29, P30 and P42 served inside a warm tail, and sources.budgets reading {"lift":600,"ring":600} on every answer.

existingEvidence.ref: _evidence/parity-step3/live/lanes/CONSOLIDATION-L12/REPORT.md §P70; lanes/L13/REPORT.md; lanes/L14/REPORT.md; lanes/L15/REPORT.md; AMENDMENTS.md R-P217, R-P229, R-P235
existingEvidence.description: At the 200 ms default 26 of 706 in-tail reads and 5 of 24 object-host probe readers were late (204–378 ms); at the 600 ms override and with P70 fix round 1 every in-tail reader was served on both hosts (46 of 46 in L14; every measured lift reader in L15).

remainingWork: Raise the exported defaults LIFT_WITNESS_BUDGET_MS and RING_READ_BUDGET_MS in src/learn/fan.ts from 200 to 600, the override's admission and refusal unchanged (closed by unit:P72.BD1 and unit:P72.BD2).

Read P62's, P68.KT3's, P70.WB2's and W10.03's (src/index.api-boundary.test.ts:284/:1726, a 500 ms hold expected refused within 400 ms) locks that pin the number 200 as the exported defaults, test-only, in the form of R-P195 (closed by unit:P72.BD2 and those locks green at the artifact).

State 600 ms and the reason in kit 02 (:369, the heartbeat/cost paragraph and the :328 sample answer), in kit 03 (one new sentence beside its sources description: the two budgets, their default and the bounded override), in src/types/env.ts's two doc comments and in the commented wrangler.toml lines (closed by unit:P72.BD3).

decisions.effect: The default is 600 ms, not 500: the value lanes L14 and L15 proved on the pair, with a buffer over the largest warm read measured (478 ms); the bounded override stays for operators.
